name: bs-skills
description: Ben Shapiro's Claude skills and plugins.

plugins.name: learning-loop
plugins.description: Helps AI work sessions hand over cleanly and keep project documents in order: handover notes in docs/handovers/, the filing standard with templates, a one-time reminder when you're leaving without a note, and what to keep when a long conversation is shortened.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Deciding what to build and getting it built well: PRDs, build specs for unattended coding agents, codebase audits for non-technical owners, changelogs, and automatic Claude reviews on GitHub pull requests.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Writing and explaining: tighten any draft without losing meaning, interactive walkthroughs of dense material, an adaptive tutor, and a build log that turns lessons into posts.

plugins.name: music
plugins.description: Songwriting and music production with Suno: from an idea to a ready-to-paste prompt, and refining across generations.
